title: What Is a Clarification? Estimating Model-Dependent Input Ambiguity
abstract: arXiv:2610.20052v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ambiguous inputs can admit multiple interpretations, each potentially yielding a different answer. Existing work largely treats this ambiguity as a property of the input, yet for a particular language model, only some alternatives may be known and answerable. We therefore distinguish world ambiguity, capturing all alternatives admitted by an input, from model ambiguity, capturing those accessible to the responding model. To characterize these alternatives, we formalize natural-language clarifications through three desiderata: \emph{uniqueness}, \emph{faithfulness}, and \emph{answer equivalence}. We show that these desiderata induce a one-to-one correspondence between valid answers and equivalence classes of clarifications, implying that any interpretation can be represented either by its answer or by the clarifications that uniquely express it. translated_title: 什么是澄清？估计依赖于模型的输入歧义
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.20052v1 公告类型：新 摘要：模糊的输入可能允许多种解释，每种解释都可能产生不同的答案。现有工作大多将这种模糊性视为输入本身的属性，然而对于特定的语言模型而言，只有部分备选解释可能是其已知且可回答的。因此，我们区分了世界歧义——即捕捉一个输入所允许的所有备选解释——与模型歧义——即捕捉响应模型所能获取的那些备选解释。为了刻画这些备选解释，我们通过三个理想标准将自然语言澄清形式化：唯一性、忠实性和答案等价性。我们证明这些理想标准在有效答案与澄清的等价类之间建立了一一对应关系，这意味着任何解释既可以由其答案来表示，也可以由唯一表达该解释的澄清来表示。我们利用这种对应关系提出了○clar，一种用于估计（模型相关输入歧义的）黑盒方法……
tldr: 该论文区分了输入固有的“世界歧义”与语言模型实际可感知的“模型歧义”，通过唯一性、忠实性和答案等价性三个标准形式化自然语言澄清，证明了有效答案与澄清等价类之间的一一对应关系，并据此提出一种黑盒方法来估计模型相关的输入歧义。
en_tdlr: The paper distinguishes world ambiguity from model ambiguity in language models, formalizes natural-language clarifications via uniqueness, faithfulness, and answer equivalence, proves a one-to-one correspondence between valid answers and equivalence classes of clarifications, and introduces a black-box method to estimate model-dependent input ambiguity.
